works: "No beautification, de-aging or face swapping" matters here because a school prom setting nudges the model toward younger faces. "The classic prom stance, one standing behind the other" gives a precise, familiar pose instead of a random embrace. tips: Upload a photo where you are standing close together and both faces are sharp; group shots with other people make it harder to keep the right faces.
If one face looks younger or different, reply "keep both faces at our real ages exactly as in the photo" and regenerate.
Change the tux to white or burgundy and the dress to a sequinned or ruffled tier style to match your real prom colours.
suits: Couples who want a playful anniversary post, friends going as prom dates, and anyone who missed their own prom; it is a strong fit for Instagram, Facebook and wedding-anniversary slideshows.
personalize: Change the tux and dress colours, the backdrop theme and the prom year to match your own school or anniversary.
